steps.page_title: AI Regulation: What the New EU Framework Means for Tech Companies — The New York Herald

actions.text: The EU's new AI framework is a necessary step toward meaningful accountability — its risk-based approach and focus on transparency set an important baseline for protecting fundamental rights. For tech companies, the challenge will be operationalizing these requirements without stifling innovation: clear, pragmatic guidance on conformity assessment, interoperable standards, and proportional obligations for SMEs will be critical. I also hope regulators prioritize funding for independent audits, support for regulatory sandboxes, and mechanisms that empower civil-society oversight. Ultimately, effective enforcement combined with industry collaboration can make this framework both protective and future-proof.
